privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Tarento is a habit-building app. This document says plainly what data we collect, why, and what you can do about it. No legal jargon.

controller.title: Who processes the data
controller.body: The app is run by one person. Data lives in Supabase (a PostgreSQL database in the European Union) and we do not sell it to anyone.

collected.title: What we collect
collected.body:
Your email address — only if you create an account. In guest mode the account is anonymous and has no address attached.
The habits you create: names, descriptions, schedules, targets.
Check-in history: what, when and with what result.
Settings: theme, language, start-of-day hour, device time zone.
Favourite quotes and the history of daily quotes.

notCollected.title: What we do not collect
notCollected.body: Location. Contacts. Photos. Data from health apps. Advertising identifiers. We do not track you outside the app and there are no ads.

analytics.title: Product analytics
analytics.body:
We collect a handful of events to know which parts of the app work: creating a habit, checking one off, hitting a streak milestone, finishing onboarding, sharing a quote, closing out a day.

Nothing you wrote goes into those events: no habit names, descriptions or notes. Only technical fields travel — unit, schedule type, streak length, item counts. The tool is PostHog.

errors.title: Crash reports
errors.body: When the app crashes we send a report to Sentry: device model, OS version and a stack trace. IP addresses and request headers are switched off. The report contains none of your habit content.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Reminders are scheduled locally, on your device. They never pass through a server, so nobody but you sees what they say.

storage.title: Where the data lives
storage.body: In a PostgreSQL database at Supabase, with Row Level Security on every table. That means the database refuses access to other people rows at the engine level, not merely in the app. Your login session is stored locally in the encrypted device store.

retention.title: For how long
retention.body: As long as you have an account. Deleting the account wipes everything immediately and irreversibly — we keep no just-in-case copies.

rights.title: What you can do
rights.body:
Export all of your data to a JSON file — one button in settings.
Delete your account along with the whole history — also from settings.
Turn notifications off in the app or in system settings.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: If we start collecting something new, this document changes together with the app and we say so in the release notes.
